scenario.summary: Threat actors are using social engineering and phishing to deploy rogue ScreenConnect instances, which سپس execute a multi-stage VBScript chain to profile hosts and deliver encrypted payloads. The campaign exhibits worm-like propagation by utilizing the ScreenConnect client to push these malicious scripts to newly connected systems, establishing persistence through registry run keys.

meta.rationale: Workstations are the primary target due to the social engineering vector. If RMM activity is found, pivot to all servers to ensure no worm-like propagation occurred.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has established long-term persistence via a 'WindowsServiceHost' registry run key and is communicating with dynamic DNS C2 infrastructure after a rogue ScreenConnect installation.

hunt.name: ScreenConnect Registry Persistence and Malicious C2
hunt.description: This hunt targets the persistence and command-and-control phases of recent rogue ScreenConnect campaigns. It identifies the creation of specific Windows Registry Run keys used to execute VBScript payloads from user AppData directories and correlates this with network telemetry pointing to known-malicious dynamic DNS domains and IP infrastructure used for staging and control.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%screenconnect%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%ultraviewer%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Filter the hunt to hosts where ScreenConnect or UltraViewer processes have executed, identifying potential beachheads.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames. Silence suggests no RMM activity, but rogue installations may be renamed or use different binaries.

primitive_config.label: Identify Hosts with ScreenConnect Activity
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%screenconnect%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%ultraviewer%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames. Silence suggests no RMM activity, but rogue installations may be renamed or use different binaries.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, reg_target, reg_value_data, time FROM hb_registry_activity WHERE LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\\software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\run%' AND reg_value_name = 'WindowsServiceHost' AND LOWER(reg_value_data) LIKE '%.vbs%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify the creation of the specific 'WindowsServiceHost' run key observed in this campaign.
config.expected_signal: Registry set operations for the malicious key name pointing to a VBScript. This is the primary persistence indicator.

primitive_config.label: Detect 'WindowsServiceHost' Persistence
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, reg_target, reg_value_data, time FROM hb_registry_activity WHERE LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\\software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\run%' AND reg_value_name = 'WindowsServiceHost' AND LOWER(reg_value_data) LIKE '%.vbs%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Registry set operations for the malicious key name pointing to a VBScript. This is the primary persistence indicator.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(reg_value_data) AS persistent_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_registry_activity WHERE LOWER(reg_target) LIKE '%\\software\\microsoft\\windows\\currentversion\\run%' AND LOWER(reg_value_data) LIKE '%.vbs%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY persistent_path HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Find rare VBS scripts executed via Run keys that might use different names than the known campaign indicator.
config.expected_signal: A list of VBScript paths appearing on very few hosts. Fleet-wide RMM scripts would be filtered out by the count.

primitive_config.label: Stack-count Rare VBS Run Keys
